# 异常值检测 v1.0.0：IQR / Z-score / iForest / LOF / DBSCAN
import io
import base64
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

method = {{method}}
detection_columns = {{detection_columns}}
detection_column = {{detection_column}}


def _to_frame(value):
    if isinstance(value, pd.DataFrame):
        return value.copy()
    if isinstance(value, bytes):
        for encoding in ('utf-8-sig', 'utf-8', 'gbk', 'gb18030'):
            try:
                return pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(value.decode(encoding)))
            except UnicodeDecodeError:
                continue
        raise RuntimeError('CSV 编码无法识别')
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(value.lstrip('\ufeff')))
    raise RuntimeError('输入 data 必须是 CSV 文本或 DataFrame')


def _plot_setup():
    import matplotlib
    matplotlib.use('Agg')
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    plt.rcParams.update({
        'font.family': 'sans-serif',
        'font.sans-serif': ['Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'],
        'axes.unicode_minus': False,
        'font.size': 10,
        'figure.facecolor': 'white',
        'axes.facecolor': 'white',
    })
    return plt


def _to_png(fig, plt):
    buffer = io.BytesIO()
    fig.savefig(buffer, format='png', dpi=300, facecolor='white', bbox_inches='tight')
    plt.close(fig)
    return 'data:image/png;base64,' + base64.b64encode(buffer.getvalue()).decode('ascii')


def _style_axes(axes):
    for ax in axes:
        ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
        ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
        ax.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.6, color='#D9DEE5', alpha=0.75)


if data is None:
    raise RuntimeError('请先连接并运行上游的数据导入插件')
df = _to_frame(data)
if df.empty:
    raise RuntimeError('输入数据为空，无法检测异常值')
if method not in ('IQR', 'Z-score', 'iForest', 'LOF', 'DBSCAN'):
    raise RuntimeError('当前版本暂不支持检测方法：' + str(method))

image = None
parameters = {}
outlier_scores = None

if method in ('IQR', 'Z-score'):
    if not detection_column:
        raise RuntimeError(str(method) + ' 方法需要选择一个检测列')
    if detection_column not in df.columns:
        raise RuntimeError('找不到检测列：' + str(detection_column))
    selected_columns = [detection_column]
    series = pd.to_numeric(df[detection_column], errors='coerce')
    valid_mask = series.notna()
    valid = series[valid_mask]
    if len(valid) < 4:
        raise RuntimeError(str(method) + ' 检测至少需要 4 个有效数值')

    if method == 'IQR':
        q1 = float(valid.quantile(0.25))
        median = float(valid.quantile(0.5))
        q3 = float(valid.quantile(0.75))
        iqr = q3 - q1
        lower = q1 - 1.5 * iqr
        upper = q3 + 1.5 * iqr
        outlier_mask = valid_mask & ((series < lower) | (series > upper))
        parameters = {
            'iqr_multiplier': 1.5, 'q1': q1, 'median': median, 'q3': q3,
            'iqr': float(iqr), 'lower_bound': float(lower), 'upper_bound': float(upper),
        }
        plt = _plot_setup()
        fig, (ax_box, ax_points) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(9.2, 4.8), gridspec_kw={'width_ratios': [0.9, 2.4]})
        ax_box.boxplot(valid.to_numpy(), vert=True, whis=1.5, widths=0.42,
                       patch_artist=True,
                       boxprops={'facecolor': '#C9DAEC', 'edgecolor': '#4F7FB3'},
                       medianprops={'color': '#D75D69', 'linewidth': 2},
                       whiskerprops={'color': '#4F7FB3'}, capprops={'color': '#4F7FB3'},
                       flierprops={'marker': 'o', 'markerfacecolor': '#DD6F75', 'markeredgecolor': 'white', 'markersize': 5})
        ax_box.set_xticks([1], [detection_column])
        ax_box.set_ylabel('数值')
        ax_box.set_title('IQR 箱线诊断', loc='left', fontweight='bold')
        normal_positions = np.flatnonzero((valid_mask & ~outlier_mask).to_numpy())
        outlier_positions = np.flatnonzero(outlier_mask.to_numpy())
        ax_points.scatter(normal_positions + 1, series.iloc[normal_positions], s=18, color='#4F7FB3', alpha=0.72, label='正常值')
        if len(outlier_positions):
            ax_points.scatter(outlier_positions + 1, series.iloc[outlier_positions], s=40, color='#DD6F75', edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.6, label='异常值', zorder=3)
        ax_points.axhline(lower, color='#DF9A3C', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.1, label='IQR 下界/上界')
        ax_points.axhline(upper, color='#DF9A3C', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.1)
        ax_points.set_xlabel('数据行号')
        ax_points.set_ylabel(detection_column)
        ax_points.set_title('异常位置', loc='left', fontweight='bold')
        ax_points.legend(frameon=False)
        _style_axes((ax_box, ax_points))
        fig.suptitle('异常值检测 · IQR', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
        fig.tight_layout()
        image = _to_png(fig, plt)
    else:
        mean = float(valid.mean())
        std = float(valid.std(ddof=0))
        if not np.isfinite(std) or std <= 0:
            raise RuntimeError('Z-score 无法用于标准差为 0 的常量列')
        z_scores = (series - mean) / std
        outlier_mask = valid_mask & (z_scores.abs() > 3.0)
        outlier_scores = z_scores.abs()
        parameters = {'threshold': 3.0, 'mean': mean, 'standard_deviation': std}
        plt = _plot_setup()
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9.2, 4.8))
        normal_positions = np.flatnonzero((valid_mask & ~outlier_mask).to_numpy())
        outlier_positions = np.flatnonzero(outlier_mask.to_numpy())
        ax.scatter(normal_positions + 1, z_scores.iloc[normal_positions], s=20, color='#4F7FB3', alpha=0.75, label='正常值')
        if len(outlier_positions):
            ax.scatter(outlier_positions + 1, z_scores.iloc[outlier_positions], s=44, color='#DD6F75', edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.6, label='异常值', zorder=3)
        ax.axhline(3.0, color='#DF9A3C', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.2, label='阈值 ±3')
        ax.axhline(-3.0, color='#DF9A3C', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.2)
        ax.axhline(0.0, color='#7589A8', linewidth=0.8)
        ax.set_xlabel('数据行号')
        ax.set_ylabel('Z-score')
        ax.set_title('异常值检测 · Z-score', loc='left', fontweight='bold')
        ax.legend(frameon=False)
        _style_axes((ax,))
        fig.tight_layout()
        image = _to_png(fig, plt)
else:
    if not isinstance(detection_columns, (list, tuple)) or not detection_columns:
        raise RuntimeError(method + ' 方法需要至少选择一个检测列')
    selected_columns = list(dict.fromkeys(detection_columns))
    missing_columns = [column for column in selected_columns if column not in df.columns]
    if missing_columns:
        raise RuntimeError('找不到检测列：' + '、'.join(map(str, missing_columns)))
    numeric = df[selected_columns].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce')
    valid_mask = numeric.notna().all(axis=1)
    valid = numeric.loc[valid_mask]
    if len(valid) < 8:
        raise RuntimeError(method + ' 检测至少需要 8 行全部检测列均有效的数据')
    if method == 'iForest':
        from sklearn.ensemble import IsolationForest
        model = IsolationForest(n_estimators=200, contamination='auto', random_state=42, n_jobs=1)
        matrix = valid.to_numpy(dtype=float)
        labels = model.fit_predict(matrix)
        scores_valid = -model.score_samples(matrix)
        parameters = {'n_estimators': 200, 'contamination': 'auto', 'random_state': 42}
    elif method == 'LOF':
        from sklearn.neighbors import LocalOutlierFactor
        from sklearn.preprocessing import RobustScaler
        matrix = RobustScaler().fit_transform(valid.to_numpy(dtype=float))
        n_neighbors = min(20, max(2, int(np.sqrt(len(valid)))))
        model = LocalOutlierFactor(n_neighbors=n_neighbors, contamination='auto')
        labels = model.fit_predict(matrix)
        scores_valid = -model.negative_outlier_factor_
        parameters = {'n_neighbors': int(n_neighbors), 'contamination': 'auto', 'scaling': 'RobustScaler'}
    else:
        from sklearn.cluster import DBSCAN
        from sklearn.neighbors import NearestNeighbors
        from sklearn.preprocessing import RobustScaler
        matrix = RobustScaler().fit_transform(valid.to_numpy(dtype=float))
        min_samples = min(10, max(3, int(np.sqrt(len(valid)))))
        neighbors = NearestNeighbors(n_neighbors=min_samples).fit(matrix)
        distances, _ = neighbors.kneighbors(matrix)
        k_distances = distances[:, -1]
        positive = k_distances[k_distances > 0]
        eps = float(np.quantile(positive, 0.90)) if len(positive) else 0.5
        eps = max(eps, 1e-6)
        labels = DBSCAN(eps=eps, min_samples=min_samples).fit_predict(matrix)
        scores_valid = k_distances
        cluster_count = len(set(labels.tolist()) - {-1})
        parameters = {
            'eps': eps, 'eps_selection': '90%分位k近邻距离',
            'min_samples': int(min_samples), 'cluster_count': int(cluster_count),
            'scaling': 'RobustScaler',
        }
    outlier_mask = pd.Series(False, index=df.index)
    outlier_mask.loc[valid.index] = labels == -1
    outlier_scores = pd.Series(np.nan, index=df.index, dtype=float)
    outlier_scores.loc[valid.index] = scores_valid

flags = outlier_mask.astype(int)
out_df = df.copy()
out_df['是否为异常值'] = flags.to_numpy(dtype=int)
outlier_positions = np.flatnonzero(outlier_mask.to_numpy())
report = {
    'method': method,
    'selected_columns': selected_columns,
    'total_rows': int(len(df)),
    'valid_rows': int(valid_mask.sum()),
    'skipped_rows': int((~valid_mask).sum()),
    'outlier_count': int(outlier_mask.sum()),
    'outlier_rate': float(outlier_mask.sum() / valid_mask.sum()),
    'outlier_row_numbers': [int(position + 1) for position in outlier_positions],
    'parameters': parameters,
    'note': '缺失或无法转换为数值的行未参与检测，原行保留且异常标记为 0。',
}
if method in ('IQR', 'Z-score'):
    report['outlier_values'] = [float(series.iloc[position]) for position in outlier_positions]
if outlier_scores is not None:
    report['outlier_scores'] = [
        {'row_number': int(position + 1), 'score': float(outlier_scores.iloc[position])}
        for position in outlier_positions
    ]
return {'data': out_df, 'image': image, 'report': report}
